label: Mother hypnotized in front of her children
group_title: Mother hypnotized while her children see it (Sep 2026)
description: Screen works worldwide where an adult mother is hypnotized, mesmerized or put in a hypnotic trance (including hypnosis-like devices) and her own child or children see it. Each record says who hypnotizes her and why, the method, how many children she has, who saw it and how they reacted, and her pregnancy status; TV records list the relevant episodes. Possession excluded; nothing where children witness sexual content.
